head.t: Medtronic announces positive real-world results on Sphere-9 catheter and PulseSelect PFA system at APHRS 2026
head.x: Medtronic has announced positive real-world registry results for the Affera mapping and ablation system with the Sphere-9 catheter and the PulseSelect pulsed field ablation (PFA) system.

head.t: Medtronic completes separation of MiniMed; diabetes business now independent on Nasdaq (MMED)
head.x: Medtronic exchanged its entire remaining MiniMed stake (252,813,348 shares) through an exchange offer 5.4 times oversubscribed, so MiniMed is now fully independent and trades as MMED on Nasdaq. Medtronic no longer holds equity in it.

head.t: Medtronic announces regulatory milestones for newest cardiac mapping and ablation software
head.x: Medtronic today announced regulatory milestones for software used with two cardiac ablation platforms, including US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) clearance and a CE mark for the latest Affera Prism-2 mapping software.

head.t: Medtronic receives US FDA Breakthrough Device designation for IN.PACT BTK drug-coated balloon
head.x: Medtronic has received US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Breakthrough Device designation for its IN.PACT below-the-knee (BTK) drug-coated balloon.

f.t: Abbott, Medtronic, Dexcom and 9 others win NHS Scotland's £140m insulin pump and CGM framework
f.x: NHS National Services Scotland has awarded a new £140 million framework for insulin infusion pumps, continuous glucose monitoring systems and associated consumables, covering all NHS Scotland health boards and NHS Northern Ireland trusts.

f.t: Contract awarded: Insulin Infusion Pumps, Continuous Glucose Monitoring Systems and Associated Consumables
f.x: Buyer: The Common Services Agency (more commonly known as NHS National Services Scotland) (NSS).
